title: Hello World
content: Welcome to Hexo! This is your very first post. Check documentation for more info. If you get any problems when using Hexo, you can find the answer in troubleshooting or you can ask me on GitHub. Quick StartCreate a new post$ hexo new My New Post More info: Writing Run server$ hexo server More info: Server Generate static files$ hexo generate More info: Generating Deploy to remote sites$ hexo deploy More info: Deployment

Chiral Client Test Chiral Client Test Page 相关文章 正在加载相关文章... console.log('=== Chiral Client Manual Debug ==='); console.log('Test page loaded'); console.log('ChiralClient available:', typeof window.ChiralClient); console.log('ChiralUtils available:', typeof window.ChiralUtils); // 手动初始化配置 const config = { hubUrl: 'https://ckc.akashio.com', nodeId: 'node_6afec7e63524cfff3db726467e743536', count: 5, enableCache: true, cacheTTL: 3600, showThumbnails: true, showExcerpts: true, containerId: 'chiral-related-posts' }; console.log('Manual config:', config); // 等待DOM完全加载后手动初始化 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { console.log('DOM loaded, starting manual initialization...'); try { // 手动初始化 console.log('Creating ChiralClient instance...'); const client = window.ChiralClient.init(config); console.log('Client created:', client); // 存储到全局变量 window.chiralClientInstance = client; console.log('Client stored globally'); } catch (error) { console.error('Manual initialization failed:', error); console.error('Error stack:', error.stack); // 显示详细错误信息 const container = document.getElementById('chiral-related-posts'); if (container) { container.innerHTML = ` 初始化失败 错误: ${error.message} ${error.stack} `; } } }); // 延迟检查初始化状态 setTimeout(() => { console.log('=== After 3 seconds ==='); console.log('chiralClientInstance:', typeof window.chiralClientInstance); if (window.chiralClientInstance) { console.log('Client info:', window.chiralClientInstance.getInfo()); // 尝试测试连接 window.chiralClientInstance.testConnection() .then(result => { console.log('Connection test result:', result); }) .catch(err => { console.error('Connection test failed:', err); }); } else { console.log('Client instance still not available'); const container = document.getElementById('chiral-related-posts'); if (container) { console.log('Current container content:', container.innerHTML); } } }, 3000);

Chiral Client Debug Test Chiral Client 详细调试 调试信息 相关文章 正在加载相关文章... function log(message) { console.log(message); const output = document.getElementById('debug-output'); if (output) { output.innerHTML += '' + message + ''; } } log('=== 开始调试 ==='); log('1. 页面加载完成'); // 检查文件是否加载 log('2. 检查依赖项...'); log(' - window 对象: ' + typeof window); log(' - document 对象: ' + typeof document); log(' - console 对象: ' + typeof console); log('4. 检查 Chiral 对象...'); log(' - ChiralClient: ' + typeof window.ChiralClient); log(' - ChiralUtils: ' + typeof window.ChiralUtils); log(' - chiralClient: ' + typeof window.chiralClient); log(' - chiralClientInstance: ' + typeof window.chiralClientInstance); // 检查脚本标签 const scriptTags = document.querySelectorAll('script[data-auto-init="true"]'); log('5. 自动初始化脚本标签数量: ' + scriptTags.length); if (scriptTags.length > 0) { const script = scriptTags[0]; log(' - data-hub-url: ' + script.getAttribute('data-hub-url')); log(' - data-node-id: ' + script.getAttribute('data-node-id')); log(' - data-container: ' + script.getAttribute('data-container')); log(' - data-auto-init: ' + script.getAttribute('data-auto-init')); } // 检查容器 const container = document.getElementById('chiral-related-posts'); log('6. 容器检查: ' + (container ? '✅ 找到' : '❌ 未找到')); // 如果 ChiralUtils 可用，尝试手动触发初始化 if (typeof window.ChiralUtils !== 'undefined') { log('7. ChiralUtils 可用，检查 ready 状态...'); log(' - document.readyState: ' + document.readyState); // 尝试手动触发自动初始化逻辑 setTimeout(() => { log('8. 3秒后检查状态...'); log(' - chiralClientInstance: ' + typeof window.chiralClientInstance); if (window.chiralClientInstance) { log(' - ✅ 实例创建成功！'); log(' - 实例信息: ' + JSON.stringify(window.chiralClientInstance.getInfo())); } else { log(' - ❌ 实例仍未创建'); // 尝试手动初始化 log('9. 尝试手动初始化...'); try { if (window.ChiralClient && window.ChiralClient.init) { const config = { hubUrl: 'https://ckc.akashio.com', nodeId: 'node_6afec7e63524cfff3db726467e743536', count: 5, enableCache: true, cacheTTL: 3600, showThumbnails: true, showExcerpts: true, containerId: 'chiral-related-posts' }; log(' - 配置: ' + JSON.stringify(config)); const client = window.ChiralClient.init(config); window.chiralClientInstance = client; log(' - ✅ 手动初始化成功！'); } else { log(' - ❌ ChiralClient.init 不可用'); } } catch (error) { log(' - ❌ 手动初始化失败: ' + error.message); log(' - 错误堆栈: ' + error.stack); } } // 最终检查容器内容 const finalContainer = document.getElementById('chiral-related-posts'); if (finalContainer) { log('10. 最终容器内容: ' + finalContainer.innerHTML.substring(0, 200) + '...'); } }, 3000); } else { log('7. ❌ ChiralUtils 不可用，文件可能没有正确加载'); }

Chiral Client 脚本执行调试 Chiral Client 脚本执行调试 调试信息 相关文章 正在加载相关文章... // 在脚本加载前设置调试 window.chiralDebugInfo = []; function addDebugInfo(message) { window.chiralDebugInfo.push(new Date().toISOString() + ': ' + message); const output = document.getElementById('debug-output'); if (output) { output.textContent = window.chiralDebugInfo.join(' '); } } addDebugInfo('Starting script load test'); // 重写console.log以捕获Chiral的日志 const originalLog = console.log; console.log = function(...args) { if (args[0] && args[0].includes && args[0].includes('Chiral')) { addDebugInfo('CHIRAL LOG: ' + args.join(' ')); } originalLog.apply(console, args); }; document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { addDebugInfo('DOM Content Loaded'); setTimeout(function() { addDebugInfo('=== After 3 seconds ==='); addDebugInfo('window.ChiralClient: ' + (typeof window.ChiralClient)); addDebugInfo('window.chiralClient: ' + (typeof window.chiralClient)); addDebugInfo('window.chiralClientInstance: ' + (typeof window.chiralClientInstance)); // 测试手动初始化 if (window.chiralClient && window.chiralClient.init) { addDebugInfo('Attempting manual initialization...'); try { const config = { hubUrl: 'https://ckc.akashio.com', nodeId: 'node_6afec7e63524cfff3db726467e743536', count: 5, enableCache: true, cacheTTL: 3600, showThumbnails: true, showExcerpts: true, containerId: 'chiral-related-posts' }; const client = window.chiralClient.init(config); addDebugInfo('Manual initialization successful!'); addDebugInfo('Client instance created: ' + (typeof client)); } catch (error) { addDebugInfo('Manual initialization failed: ' + error.message); } } else { addDebugInfo('Manual initialization not available'); } }, 3000); }); addDebugInfo('Script tag loaded'); // 立即检查脚本标签 const scriptTags = document.querySelectorAll('script[data-auto-init="true"]'); addDebugInfo('Found ' + scriptTags.length + ' auto-init script tags'); if (scriptTags.length > 0) { const script = scriptTags[0]; addDebugInfo('Script src: ' + script.src); addDebugInfo('Script data-hub-url: ' + script.getAttribute('data-hub-url')); addDebugInfo('Script data-node-id: ' + script.getAttribute('data-node-id')); addDebugInfo('Script data-auto-init: ' + script.getAttribute('data-auto-init')); }

Chiral Client Auto-Init Test Chiral Client 自动初始化测试 相关文章 正在加载相关文章... console.log('=== Auto-Init Test ==='); console.log('Page loaded, waiting for auto-initialization...'); // 检查初始化状态 setTimeout(() => { console.log('=== After 3 seconds ==='); console.log('chiralClientInstance:', typeof window.chiralClientInstance); if (window.chiralClientInstance) { console.log('✅ Auto-initialization successful!'); console.log('Client info:', window.chiralClientInstance.getInfo()); } else { console.log('❌ Auto-initialization failed'); const container = document.getElementById('chiral-related-posts'); if (container) { console.log('Container content:', container.innerHTML); } } }, 3000);

Chiral Client Simple Test Chiral Client 最简测试 基础检查 相关文章 正在加载相关文章... function simpleLog(message) { console.log('SIMPLE TEST: ' + message); const output = document.getElementById('debug-simple-output'); if (output) { output.innerHTML += '' + message + ''; } } simpleLog('1. 页面基础脚本开始执行'); simpleLog('2. document.currentScript: ' + (document.currentScript ? 'available' : 'null')); simpleLog('3. Chiral 脚本加载后'); simpleLog('4. window.ChiralClient: ' + typeof window.ChiralClient); simpleLog('5. window.ChiralUtils: ' + typeof window.ChiralUtils); simpleLog('6. window.chiralClientInstance: ' + typeof window.chiralClientInstance); // 检查是否有任何 Chiral 相关的全局变量 const chiralKeys = Object.keys(window).filter(key => key.toLowerCase().includes('chiral')); simpleLog('7. Chiral 相关全局变量: ' + chiralKeys.join(', ')); // 尝试直接调用 ChiralUtils.log if (typeof window.ChiralUtils !== 'undefined' && window.ChiralUtils.log) { try { window.ChiralUtils.log('Direct ChiralUtils.log test', 'info'); simpleLog('8. ✅ ChiralUtils.log 工作正常'); } catch (error) { simpleLog('8. ❌ ChiralUtils.log 错误: ' + error.message); } } else { simpleLog('8. ❌ ChiralUtils.log 不可用'); } // 检查 document.currentScript simpleLog('9. 当前脚本检查完成，document.currentScript: ' + (document.currentScript ? document.currentScript.src : 'null')); // 延迟检查 setTimeout(() => { simpleLog('10. 5秒后检查...'); simpleLog(' - chiralClientInstance: ' + typeof window.chiralClientInstance); const container = document.getElementById('chiral-related-posts'); if (container) { simpleLog(' - 容器内容长度: ' + container.innerHTML.length + ' 字符'); simpleLog(' - 容器内容预览: ' + container.innerHTML.substring(0, 100) + '...'); } }, 5000);
